subject: Post-call: request for org map, approval journey & list of decision criteria
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Gupta <samir.gupta@healthwave.com>, Alice Monroe <alice.monroe@healthwave.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: request for org map, approval journey & list of decision criteria

Hi Samir / Alice —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and a couple of asks so we can keep momentum: 

- What we heard: HealthWave is evaluating inference vendors to reduce per-token spend and improve 95th percentile latency for your clinical summarization pipeline. Key constraints are PHI handling, SOC 2 evidence, and predictable throughput during daily batch windows.
- Redwood next steps (from our side): prepare a short security checklist and a proposal showing two config options (dedicated pool vs private VPC) with estimated monthly costs.

Could you please send: 
1) A simple org map or list of the approval chain for this project (who signs commercial, who owns procurement, and who signs on legal/security). If you have a one-page org chart, that would be perfect.
2) Any specific decision criteria or scorecards you’ll use (e.g., SOC 2 + encryption, SLA, price target, vendor onboarding timeline).
3) Primary procurement contact and an expected procurement timeline (procurement lead name + email).

If easier, feel free to forward a short email chain or attach the procurement checklist — we’ll map responsibilities and provide a tailored mutual action plan.

I’ve copied Karthik (technical lead) and Vanessa (security/enterprise) so we can coordinate answers and next steps quickly. Proposed next milestone: short follow-up (15–20 min) the week of Sep 21 to run through the org map and outstanding questions.

Thanks —
Neha Kapoor
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0182

Attachments: none in this message
From: Samir Gupta <samir.gupta@healthwave.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alice Monroe <alice.monroe@healthwave.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2026 09:44:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Post-call: request for org map, approval journey & list of decision criteria

Neha —

Thanks for the clear summary and the ask. I’ve attached a short PDF with procurement and legal contacts (healthwave_procurement_contacts.pdf). High level here:

- Economic buyer: Priya Shah, VP Product (not on call today) — final sign-off on budget.
- Procurement lead: Jorge Ramos (procurement) — manages vendor onboarding and PO issuance.
- Legal: Alice Monroe is our in-house counsel for vendor contracts (cc’d).
- Security/Privacy: I’ve included our security manager (not on this thread) in the attachment; they will need SOC 2 + data handling answers.

Decision criteria (informal, but what they use):
  * Security & compliance: SOC 2 type II, encryption at rest & in transit, PHI controls
  * Cost: within target TCO range — we are looking for predictable monthly committed pricing or clear burst pricing guidance
  * Performance: sub-200ms median for short prompts, <1s 95th for medium-length summarizations
  * Integration effort & onboarding time (2–4 weeks preferred)

Timeline: procurement opens on Oct 4 internally; expect final decision by Nov 1 if the procurement and security reviews go smoothly.

I attached a risk matrix too (healthwave_risk_matrix.xlsx) — that should help you anticipate the security questions.

Samir
Director, Applied ML | HealthWave
samir.gupta@healthwave.com | +1 (617) 555-3021

Attachments: healthwave_procurement_contacts.pdf; healthwave_risk_matrix.xlsx
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Samir Gupta <samir.gupta@healthwave.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2026 11:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: request for org map, approval journey & list of decision criteria

Thanks Samir — this is super helpful. Two quick notes from our side: 

1) Security artifacts: Vanessa, can you own a short SOC 2 + PHI summary and a one-page onboarding checklist we can share with Jorge and the security manager? I’ll draft a brief performance runbook that maps to their latency targets.

2) For procurement timing: if procurement opens Oct 4, we should prepare a one-pager with pricing bands (dedicated vs private) + a recommended fallback for cost (e.g., quantized v2 model) so they can see clear trade-offs in week 1 of evaluation.

Samir — would it help if we also provided a proposed mutual action plan (timeline + deliverables) and a suggested SOW template to accelerate Jorge’s review? Happy to draft and share a DocuSign-ready copy.

Karthik
Technical Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.ai | +1 (408) 555-9983
